text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to club y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for club y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Born(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ (FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ LoanedTo(ailtonSilva, braga)) ∧ (FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico)) ∧ (Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga)) ∧ Club(fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga. Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
